title: Pix internal transaction reported
description: This event is generated when a Pix internal transaction occurs and is reported. You can use this event to track internal Pix transaction progress, completion, or failure.

end_to_end_id.title: End-to-end-ID
end_to_end_id.description: Unique Pix transaction identifier. This field is a Brazil Central Bank (BCB) requirement to track all steps of Pix transactions.

initiation_type.title: Initiation type
initiation_type.description: Transaction initiation type. Refer to the [Pix-out transfer](https://developers.pismo.io/pismo-docs/reference/post-pix-out-transfer) endpoint for enum descriptions

account_number.title: Account number
account_number.description: Payee account number plus check digit (verifier). Format: account number + check digit. Example: '9876543' (account number) + '2' (check digit) = '98765432'.

bank.title: Bank
bank.description: Payee's bank code - ISPB (Identificador do Sistema de Pagamento Brazil), an 8-digit value.

document_number.title: Payee's document number
document_number.description: Government-issued ID such as a tax registration ID (CPF/CNPJ). Must be numeric with 11–14 digits.

account_type.title: Account Type
account_type.description: Payee account type. Refer to the [Pix-out transfer](https://developers.pismo.io/pismo-docs/reference/post-pix-out-transfer) endpoint for enum descriptions

account_number.title: Account number
account_number.description: Payer account number plus check digit (verifier). Format: account number + hyphen (-) +  check digit. For example - '1234567-8'.

bank.title: Bank
bank.description: Payer's bank code - ISPB (Identificador do Sistema de Pagamento Brazil), an 8-digit value.

document_number.title: Payer's document number
document_number.description: Government-issued ID, such as a tax registration ID (CPF/CNPJ). Must be numeric with 11–14 digits.

account_type.title: Account type
account_type.description: Payer's account type. Refer to the [Pix-out transfer](https://developers.pismo.io/pismo-docs/reference/post-pix-out-transfer) endpoint for enum descriptions

original_transaction.title: Original transaction
original_transaction.description: Reference to the original transaction in case of refund

key.title: Pix key
key.description: Pix key used in the transaction such as an email or mobile number

error_code.title: Error code
error_code.description: Error code in case of failure

error_message.title: Error message
error_message.description: Error message in case of failure
